WITH pairs AS (
  SELECT s.transref, tr.tradekind, AVG(s.anlycount) AS avg_cnt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg
  JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg
  GROUP BY s.transref, tr.tradekind
),
m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cnt) AS overall FROM pairs WHERE avg_cnt IS NOT NULL),
kept AS (
  SELECT p.tradekind, p.avg_cnt, p.avg_cnt - m.overall AS diff
  FROM pairs p, m
  WHERE p.avg_cnt > m.overall
),
agg AS (
  SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_cnt) AS avg_analyst, AVG(diff) AS avg_above
  FROM kept
  GROUP BY tradekind
)
SELECT tradekind, avg_analyst, avg_above,
       avg_analyst / (SELECT AVG(avg_analyst) FROM agg) AS ratio_to_mean
FROM agg
